description: Public mathematics track: arXiv math.* titles and abstracts, fixed-LoRA protocol as reported in the paper

corpus.source: arXiv OAI-PMH metadata feed, math.* categories, titles and abstracts only
corpus.availability_note: arXiv releases its article metadata, including titles and abstracts, under CC0 1.0; the corpus is published in this repository so anyone can reproduce the track.
corpus.rebuild: python tools/prepare_math_corpus.py build-corpus --source arxiv --from-date 2026-06-09 --until-date 2026-08-20 --forbidden-shingles tools/data/gsm8k_test_shingles.json --out math_arxiv.jsonl

adaptation.selection: fixed configuration shared by every model

contamination.interpretation: every document postdates every model in the cohort; an n-gram screen additionally removes overlap with the GSM8K test set
